final: SELECT g.link_to_member, g.position, g.cnt AS group_count, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM (SELECT a.link_to_member AS link_to_member, m.position AS position, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position) g JOIN (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position) WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
